headline: European DN to invest nearly 35,000 billion dong, wants to build a floating model at sea never seen before in Vietnam's largest special zone
summary: A company identified as European DN plans to invest nearly 35,000 billion dong in a floating model at sea. The report says it would be the first model of its kind in Vietnam.
why: Large foreign direct investment projects in Vietnam's special economic zones signal investor appetite and can affect local industrial and energy supply chains.
